text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 1.5% over the past day, suggesting modest profit-taking rather than panic selling. The Fear & Greed Index sits at 69 (Greed) despite a 5-point weekly decline, indicating investors still lean bullish but are beginning to temper enthusiasm. Bitcoin's dominance at 59.1% combined with $78B in daily volume reflects moderate activity—enough to sustain current levels without the conviction needed to push significantly higher.
